question: Eight teachers Jatin, Abhi, Gopal, Heena, Ishaa, Rohit, Kajal and Leela are sitting around a circular table facing opposite to the centre (not necessarily in the same order). Abhi is second to the left of Heena. Rohit is third to the right of Heena. Gopal is second to the right of Jatin. Rohit is second to the left of Jatin. Kajal is third to the left of Ishaa. Who is sitting to the immediate left of Gopal?
solution:
**Given:** Eight teachers Jatin, Abhi, Gopal, Heena, Ishaa, Rohit, Kajal and Leela are sitting around a circular table facing opposite to the centre.

1) Abhi is second to the left of Heena.

2) Rohit is third to the right of Heena. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f42caeb456249729c0b13f2ecde2367e62a2921370954d8f4fc15a4772d55061.png] 

3) Rohit is second to the left of Jatin.
